job.job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer
Experience: 35 Years
Location: Pune / Nagpur (Work from Office)




Job Summary

We are seeking an AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, MLOps, forecasting, and production-grade AI application development. The candidate will design, deploy, monitor, and optimize scalable AI and ML systems.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and deploy production-grade AI and machine learning solutions.
Build LLM applications using LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
Design multi-step workflows involving planning, retrieval, memory, validation, guardrails, and human approval.
Develop models for classification, regression, predictive analytics, and forecasting.
Manage the complete ML lifecycle from data preparation to deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
Build AI APIs, microservices, and model-serving applications.
Implement CI/CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and model monitoring.
Evaluate LLM and RAG applications for accuracy, relevance, cost, latency, safety, and hallucination.
Monitor model performance, data drift, reliability, and production issues.
Collaborate with product, engineering, data, and business teams.



Mandatory Skills

3–5 years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
Hands-on production experience developing and deploying AI/ML applications.
Strong experience with LangChain and LangGraph.
Strong understanding of RAG, LLM orchestration, agentic AI, and tool/function calling.
Experience with prompt design, embeddings, document chunking, indexing, retrieval, and reranking.
Experience with vector databases and semantic search.
Experience evaluating LLM outputs and implementing validation, guardrails, observability, and hallucination-reduction techniques.
Strong knowledge of ML model development, training, validation, evaluation, and hyperparameter optimization.
Experience with classification, regression, predictive analytics, and time-series modelling.
Experience delivering at least one forecasting or predictive analytics solution.
Experience with FastAPI or Flask for REST APIs and microservices.
Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with Docker and cloud deployment.
Understanding of CI/CD, model serving, experiment tracking, model versioning, and monitoring.



Good to Have

Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Databricks, Azure ML, or AWS SageMaker.
Experience with Kubernetes and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases.
Experience with Git, automated testing, observability, and logging tools.
Experience optimizing AI applications for cost, latency, throughput, and reliability.
Experience with human-in-the-loop approval workflows.
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
